name: RVAutumn Big and Silent 2026
information: **This competition only has side events and not 3x3x3 Cube, therefore, we do not recommend it for new competitors. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in Virginia](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Virginia); Such as [RVAutumn 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RVAutumn2026).** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Additionally, we recommend you attend the Newcomer Tutorial at the beginning of the Competition.
